completion.title: Completion rules
completion.intro: Choose what a student must do to earn the certificate of this course.
completion.noExam: No final exam — certificate after completing the lessons
completion.finalExamHint: With a final exam, the certificate stays locked until the student’s best graded attempt reaches the passing score. An inactive exam does not lock certificates.
completion.noQuizzes: This course has no quiz yet.
completion.allowRestart: Allow students to restart this course
completion.allowRestartHint: Restarting resets lesson progress to 0%. Exam attempts already used are kept (restarting does not give extra attempts) and an issued certificate stays valid.
completion.globalHint: Defaults for every course (minimum lesson progress and the passing score used when a quiz leaves it empty) are in Settings → Certificate.
completion.saveFailed: Could not save the completion rules.
